# Command reference

Manage database account credentials with a vault as the master record.

Each page below covers one command, or one group of commands. It gives
each command's usage line, its help text and its options. The pages are
generated from the same definitions that `--help` reads.

- [`sopuli about`](about.md): Show the sopuli-dba banner, tagline, and project links.
- [`sopuli account`](account.md): Act on an account a person owns, rather than one an application uses.
- [`sopuli config`](config.md): Inspect and validate configuration.
- [`sopuli creds`](creds.md): Manage application database account credentials.
- [`sopuli doctor`](doctor.md): Check that every target can be reached, and report what it is.
- [`sopuli lock`](lock.md): Show the advisory locks, and break one.
- [`sopuli policy`](policy.md): Inspect password policies.
- [`sopuli target`](target.md): Inspect the estate.
- [`sopuli vault`](vault.md): Look at what the stores hold beyond what the config declares.

## Global options

Every command except `about` takes these options, after the command name.

- `--debug`: Write debug output to stderr: each statement sent to a database and each request sent to a vault, with the time it took. Not a stable format.
- `--color` `auto|always|never`: Colour in text output. auto follows the terminal; NO_COLOR disables it.  [default: auto]
- `--profile` `NAME`: Run under a profile declared in `profiles:`. Not a selector: it changes how the run behaves, never what it acts on.
- `--output` `text|json|jsonl`: Output format. Scripts should read json, never text.  [default: text]
- `--vault-addr` `URL`: Address of the default vault: the store that `SOPULI_VAULT` or `defaults.vault` names. Refused when neither names one.
- `--vault-token-file` `PATH`: File that holds the vault token. It is the command line's place in the token chain; the token itself is never an option value.
- `--dry-run`: Print the plan and make no changes.
- `--config` `PATH` (repeatable): Config file. Repeat to layer files left to right.
